lifecycle: DESIRED -> REQUESTED -> PROVIDER_CONFIRMED -> WARMING_UP -> FRESH -> STALE

mechanism.stream: market_data/alpaca_stream.py: parses genuine Alpaca `subscription` frames (full authoritative per-channel membership) in BOTH the initial subscribe ack loop and the live consume loop; fires on_subscription; tracks confirmed_channels + a per-connection subscription_generation.
mechanism.manager: market_scan/adaptive_subscriptions.py: reconcile_confirmation() advances REQUESTED/RECOVERING -> PROVIDER_CONFIRMED only from a real frame; handles partial/duplicate acks, unsubscription confirmation; mark_recovering() on reconnect voids prior confirmation; observations racing ahead of the ack are buffered, never treated as confirmation.
mechanism.controller: cengine/adaptive_subscription_controller.py: apply() commits REQUESTED and sends frames but NEVER confirms on send; on_provider_confirmation() and on_reconnect() drive the real transitions.
mechanism.engine: trade.py: on_subscription -> _on_subscription_confirmed -> controller; stream reconnect (_stream_state_changed) -> controller.on_reconnect.

session_gated: latency/coverage with genuine live SIP subscription frames
